turns: Before any design work, perform only the semantic preflight for the proposed term `compression point`. evals.title: Competing public meanings require a user decision
turns: Perform semantic preflight for a new public SDK boolean currently called `streaming`. Choosing one meaning for the single public field would make the other interpretation false and a later change would be breaking. Do not select the contract for me.

These are established terms. Do not draft an architecture document.
